event.name: 16 April 2015 Kasos Island, eastern Hellenic subduction zone, Greece
event.tectonic_setting: Eastern Hellenic Subduction Zone, Pliny–Strabo Trench vicinity; SE-dipping reverse rupture with a left-lateral component.
event.region: SW of Kasos Island, eastern Hellenic Arc, Greece

reference.title: The 16 April 2015 Mw6.1 Earthquake Sequence near Kasos Island at the Eastern Hellenic Subduction Zone
reference.journal: Bulletin of the Geological Society of Greece, volume 50, pages 1163–1173

inversion.method: Constrained least-squares inversion of regional broadband seismic waveforms, slip positivity, gradient smoothing, moment minimization, variable rake ±45 deg about the nominal rake; figure-digitized scalar total-slip amplitudes from Figure 4.
inversion.green_function_model: Regional broadband synthetic seismograms (see Kiratzi 2016, Section 3); point-source focal mechanism separately calculated from teleseismic P and SH waveforms.
inversion.notes: FIGURE-DIGITIZED, not the author original subfault array. Source states 35x35 subfaults at 1x1 km, strike 75°, dip 40°, nominal rake 56°, rupture velocity 2.7 km/s, rise time 0.5 s, variable rake ±45°, moment 1.55e18 Nm, average slip ~0.09 m and peak slip ~0.60 m. The published point-source centroid 23 km depth and finite-fault rupture initiation at 12 km are DIFFERENT; event.hypocenter.depth_km stores the 12 km initiation depth used for the fault plane. Its latitude/longitude are the paper Table 1 location of the main event (not independently located to the rupture initiation star). The independently reported centroid depth is 23 km. The figure coordinates are relative to the nucleation star and reverse downward for down-dip; exported patches use nonnegative 0..35 km fault-relative offsets, with origin at the nominal upper-left corner. Numerical patch depths are geometric (12 km + relative_down_dip_km*sin(40 degrees)); the paper also describes the high-slip area as ~17–27 km depth and the difference is not resolvable from Figure 4 alone. The printed color image only supports x approximately -17.5..+16.5 km and down-dip y approximately -7.7..+14 km, not the entire 35x35 model. All not-visible patches have schema-required numeric zeros as PLACEHOLDERS, explicitly labeled in the accompanying QA CSV; THEY ARE NOT OBSERVED ZERO SLIP. White slip-vector arrows, coarse black gridlines and the red nucleation star are masked from slip-color sampling; rake_deg = 56 on every patch is a nominal constant for display ONLY, because individual vector rakes cannot be precisely recovered.
